title: Relight It
author: Marisol Reyes, rigger
pages: Dell's gone up the ridge for good. Odessa is in the warehouse with what's left of Rudy. I'm the last of Kiln & Co.

We cut the Heart open for scrap money and it took the city. If you've found this, the relays still carry. One district at a time: that's how it took Asheville, and that's how you take it back. Relight it.
